imageSource: Official upstream release image. Digest is the OCI index digest read from registry-1.docker.io for tag v2026.9.24; never a floating tag.
entrypoint: upstream image default (/opt/hermes/docker/entrypoint-dispatch.sh -> s6-overlay /init); no override
runtimeUser: container starts as root; s6 drops supervised processes to the image hermes user UID 10000 (HERMES_UID/HERMES_GID=10000)

secrets.source: Dokploy compose env for composeId kl7tmNAE6_kbE_c7q6l2I (written by Dokploy as .env next to the compose file); names only in Git

telegramBotToken.mustEqual: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in /srv/viewport/runtime/hermes-viewport-v2026-8-27/.env (compare sha256 prefixes only, never print values)
telegramBotToken.mustNotEqual: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in /srv/viewport/secrets/platformx.env (OpenClaw's bot; sharing one bot token between two pollers causes Telegram 409 and breaks both)

legacyStateEnv.reason: The upstream image reads API keys from /opt/data/.env and loads it with override=True, so keys present there win over compose env. The fork secret-init entrypoint (exit 78 on this file) is not used by this contract. Nothing is moved or deleted.

dashboard.auth: basic auth via HERMES_DASHBOARD_BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME/PASSWORD (required on the default non-loopback bind)

dockerSocket.decision: keep: live Hermes runs docker commands against the viewport daemon; upstream stage2-hook adds the socket GID to the hermes user

prerequisitesBeforeDeploy: Switch the Dokploy record kl7tmNAE6_kbE_c7q6l2I to this Git source first: today it is sourceType=raw, composePath=./docker-compose.yml, no customGitUrl/customGitBranch and an empty env (read-only Dokploy DB check, 2026-09-30). Set sourceType=git, customGitUrl=https://github.com/viewport-corp/fork-hermes-agent.git, customGitBranch=main, composePath=deploy/docker-compose.yml. A deploy of the raw record ignores this repo.
Put every secrets.requiredEnv name, plus the wanted secrets.optionalEnv names, into that record's env. Compose fails closed on a missing required name.
Run rollback.backupBeforeDeploy and record Sam's named approval for the live recreate in viewport-corp/viewport-ops#572.

rollback.method: Dokploy compose.stop for kl7tmNAE6_kbE_c7q6l2I, then docker start the stopped previous container hermes-viewport-v2026-8-27 (previous image sha256:dcf3b96c40d1b1bbe64c448be102ca97146f66df91a4f228d4ae581bc841fadd, local only; never prune it). If state is damaged, restore the backup below into a NEW sibling folder and point the compose there; never rsync --delete over live state.
backupBeforeDeploy: Check df -h /srv has room for the state folder (about 58G) plus margin.
Save docker inspect hermes-viewport-v2026-8-27 and the Dokploy compose.one record for kl7tmNAE6_kbE_c7q6l2I into the backup dir (mode 600; they hold secret values).
docker stop hermes-viewport-v2026-8-27 (stop only, never rm), then rsync pass 2 into the same backup state dir.
Pre-pull the pinned digest into docker-viewport with deploy/prepull-ghcr-image.sh before compose.deploy.
